g.text: From mainframe source to requirements and business rules your business can review
Prerequisites → Sign in → Source → AWS Transform and Claude → Reconcile → Review
Assess mainframe source with AWS Transform: with no options, a guided run that
checks and sets up everything first; the AWS resources stay until reframe teardown
Check and set up the prerequisites and the AWS sign-in, without starting a run
The run's stage, the job's plan steps, any waiting question and the next step
Show AWS's waiting question, or answer it
Continue a run that stopped; nothing with a receipt is repeated
Build the HTML report from the run's downloads again
The Claude assessment: assess the same snapshot with Claude's code-modernization
plugin, show it in the same business review, load its graph into the run's Neptune
cluster, and compare it with AWS Transform's results
The reconciliation: decide every rule the two assessments do not agree on against
the source code, with evidence Reframe checks, then write recommended
requirements, one SME list and the reconciliation page; needs both assessments
Read the review downloads in a folder and show each reviewer's coverage, sign-offs
and where reviewers disagree; runs nothing, and the next reframe reconcile
--context with the same folder combines them
Write a run's reconciled results as one Excel workbook: domains, functions,
capabilities, requirements, business rules, decision tables, open questions and
the SME list, with the reviewers' marks; runs nothing
Build the page comparing AWS Transform's and Claude's results again
Copy a run's reports, cleaned of the AWS account's identifiers, into a folder
